actionResult.summary: 043 已完整关闭042的B1-RA-003/B1-RA-004：Reviewer immutable target drift重新 fail-closed，Apply/revise-apply self-owned progress continuation保持，persisted pending archive在OpenSpec relocation或Change completed后可恢复同一runId，completed无pending不会创建新archive。但完整archive闭环仍有两个author blocker：B1-RA-005，completed后resume成功但admitActionResult仍强制active Change，terminal result无法发布；B1-RA-006，同一可恢复pending archive在inspect/status/doctor/resume-context中因无active Change被误报为none。SHA90/90、focused87/87、affected609/609、full regression638/638、typecheck/lint/build/quality、OpenSpec strict、lineage/hygiene与cumulative diagnostics均通过。

reviewFindings.title: pending archive 在 Change completed 后虽可 resume，但 terminal admission 仍要求 active Change
reviewFindings.problem: 043 修复了 persisted pending archive preparation/resume，但 admitActionResult 仍要求 getActiveChange(snapshot) 存在且等于 package.changeId。archive 的合法 output 本身包含 Change active→completed，因此 Reviewer 实测 prepare archive→mark completed→resume same runId 后提交 completed result，仍被 PENDING_INPUT_DRIFT 拒绝，无法发布 terminal result.json。

reviewFindings.title: persisted pending archive 可恢复，但 inspect/status/doctor/resume-context 在 completed seam 误报无 pending Run
